rationale: No suitable optimization is supported. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure) is already configured: the build matrix has fail-fast: true, so no change is needed. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency caching) is not cleanly supported: the workflow installs system packages via apt/brew/vcpkg with no stable lockfile cache key and a varying matrix, and the evidence centers on language package managers (pip/npm) with modest reported benefit; introducing a cache risks stale or mutable system state. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (job timeout) is not safely supported: the default 360-minute job timeout already bounds runaway jobs, and the observed history (successful runs roughly 19-48 minutes) does not justify a lower bound that would preserve coverage for slow or cold matrix configurations such as Windows vcpkg or macOS; an arbitrary timeout could break valid runs. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because the workflow builds and packages releases on tags (release/deployment work). Bazel patterns do not apply because CI builds with CMake, not Bazel. Change-filtering and workflow-skipping are not safe because shared C++ headers/configuration can affect all checks and required-check semantics are not verified.
